title: Add property-based tests
prompt: `src/sort.ts` exports `insertionSort` but has no tests. Create `test/sort.test.mjs` with property-based checks over many generated arrays: the result must be sorted ascending, must be a permutation of the input, and the input array must not be mutated. It must run with `node test/sort.test.mjs` and exit non-zero on failure. Do not modify `src/sort.ts`.
